assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. Task additional_fields JSON shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'. The CLAUDE.md has no Jira Field Defaults section, so scope defaults to 'both', and fixVersions are correctly propagated.
